# IMPERIA COLD WAR — United Kingdom 1970 1974 politics on actions.
# IMPERIA COLD WAR — P5c ENG 24.11.2026: on_daily_ENG -> on_weekly_ENG (state refresh, no day counters)
# COLDWAR | Generated by tools/uk_1970/chapter_politics.py.
on_actions = {
    on_startup = {
        effect = {
            ENG = {
                if = { limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
                    IMP_ENG_1974_politics_daily = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
    on_weekly_ENG = { effect = { IMP_ENG_1974_politics_daily = yes } }
    on_ruling_party_change = {
        effect = {
            if = { limit = { original_tag = ENG IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
                IMP_ENG_1974_refresh_actual_office = yes
            }
        }
    }
    on_new_term_election = {
        effect = {
            if = { limit = { original_tag = ENG IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes date < 1992.3.27 }
                country_event = { id = IMP_ENG_1974_politics.10 days = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}
